5194780.desc: 一路开火，闯过 99 个彻底疯狂的平台动作关卡！操控 Radical Rob，收集罐子、击晕敌人、获取奖励并找到出口。体验这款色彩鲜艳、充满 90 年代风格的 PC 平台游戏。

5195560.name: Pocket Dynasty
5195560.desc: 用现代复古像素风格执教一支美式橄榄球队。亲自呼叫每一次战术，把耳机交给协调员，或者亲自上场持球。选秀新秀，请传奇球星回归担任教练，冲击总冠军，并在同一台电脑上或在线挑战好友。

5196520.name: Why Did You Pay $1,000?!
5196520.desc: 你刚刚花了 1,000 美元，购买了史上最昂贵的游戏之一。 在 Why Did You Pay $1,000?! 中，你正在参加一场史上最昂贵的会谈……但你知道为什么吗？背后隐藏着什么？

5196730.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
5196730.desc: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is an SNES-era inspired top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, collect tools, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade wi…

5198880.name: Tchenovstok
5198880.desc: Welcome to Tchenovstok: A state-mandated atmospheric anti-game built under a strict 100-hour plan.There is no main menu. There is no DLC. There is no exit button. There is only you, a bleak 1980s Soviet concrete grid, …

5201500.name: NecroSmash
5201500.desc: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new…

5202040.name: Monsters Can Cook
5202040.desc: 你前世是个坏人，所以死后还得当个见习厨师。购买来路不明的食材，为客人做饭，不断提升厨艺，直到你的餐厅获得五星评级。

5202110.name: Kabakura
5202110.desc: 《Kyabakura Wars》是一款内嵌视觉小说的日式夜总会（卡巴库拉）经营模拟游戏。接手一家负债累累的夜总会，把它打造成全城最好的店，并击败挡在你成名路上的四位对手老板。

5203260.name: 卡德戴斯
5203260.desc: 一款以赌场骰子为主题的挂机闯关游戏。卡片骰自动投掷，在限时对局中战胜对手。收集宝石与刻印，搭配不同流派，汰换升级装备，逐步挑战更高等级的赌桌。

5206930.name: A Drop of Magenta
5206930.desc: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

5210430.name: Break the Piñatas
5210430.desc: 一款以打碎1000个皮纳塔为目标的放置类游戏!赚取糖果,购买升级,解锁独特技能,成为最强者。那么,我们要在最后一个皮纳塔前停下吗?

5211000.name: Dough Not Waste
5211000.desc: 在这款温馨的增量烘焙游戏中，擀开面团、压出饼干，再装饰每一批成品。巧妙摆放模具以减少浪费，完成节日订单，解锁更好的设备，让小小的烘焙坊变得像家一样温暖。

5214970.name: Music Maniaz
5214970.desc: 敲鼓就能玩的音游，塞满 Lofi 曲目，谁都能上手。（仅 Lofi 就有 20 首以上！） 收录 50 首以上多风格原创曲！除鼓以外还能选旋律、All Mix，三档难度！ 除了原创曲，还能添加自己喜欢的歌并自动生成谱面，尽情畅玩！

5220580.name: Pixireels
5220580.desc: Pixireels is a cozy pixel-art slot roguelike where you stack rule-breaking coins, chain runaway multipliers, watch a tiny score get out of hand through runs, and squeeze thirty rounds per run to unlock who knows what. …

5224030.name: FROG IS CRIME
5224030.desc: Complete unhinged jobs in the best OPEN WORLD RAGE GAME of 2026 or cry trying!

5228130.name: 电网大亨
5228130.desc: 《电网大亨》是一款融合电力仿真与策略经营的3D建造游戏。亲手规划变电站、放置变压器与开关设备、铺设三相线路，将发电机组的电力送往住宅、商业与工业负荷。操作断路器和隔离开关，观察电压、电流、线损与保护动作，在供电稳定和建设成本之间作出选择。通过售电收益、设备升级与日常维护扩大电网，应对天气变化、设备老化和突发故障。你可以从新手教程与关卡目标入门，也可以在沙盒中开启无限预算，自由搭建和反复试验，借助设备百科了解电网如何运转。

5232860.name: Ghost//Root
5232860.desc: Enter a locked network through one surviving terminal. Read conflicting records, question witnesses, and use recovered programs to uncover why an autonomous machine refused its orders. A retro terminal mystery in four …

5234330.name: 整理个球
5234330.desc: 整理个球！一款解压治愈的整理游戏：拆开无数个扭蛋球，整理并收集可爱的玩具球。有条不紊，把它们整理得像个球一样！

5239830.name: Zombie Apocalypse Together
5239830.desc: 在每局都焕然一新的世界里，与丧尸搏杀、搜刮城市、探索荒野、狩猎、制作并建造基地。从一无所有开始，与最多 3 名好友一起活下去。每逢第七夜，血月都会把尸潮引到你的墙下。

5243130.name: Desktop Tower
5243130.desc: 《Desktop Tower》是一款在屏幕一角运行的放置塔防游戏。工作、学习或处理日常事务时，守住阵地，击退一波又一波敌人。

5250930.name: Heaps: Special Interest Sandbox
5250930.desc: Heaps is a genre-defining sandbox game that builds the universe of you. In Heaps, your real world interests generate endless 3D worlds giving you the creative freedom to explore, discover and evolve. All in an environm…

5254210.name: Coins in Place
5254210.desc: 一款短篇放置类游戏，目标是捡起每一枚硬币。一天结束前哪怕漏掉一枚，你就得再干一周！购买升级，招募猫咪来帮忙，用你自己的方式达成完美的一周。每一枚硬币，各就各位。

5255070.name: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2
5255070.desc: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2 - The best comic-book card game in ANY multiverse!

5259120.name: Dark Hours: Anomalies
5259120.desc: 《至暗时刻：异常现象》是一款合作恐怖游戏，支持 1-4 名玩家。恶作剧恶魔已经将你们这群窃贼困入了一个无尽的循环。记住每个房间，找出异常现象，打破诅咒。漏掉一个就得从头再来。你们是会打败他，还是会永远被困在其中？

5268650.name: CatchCatch
5268650.desc: 这是一款支持 3～10 名玩家在线游玩的捉人游戏。 逃跑者需要躲避捉人者并收集物件，而捉人者则可以诅咒逃跑者或腐化物件！

5269310.name: Averlyn
5269310.desc: Build a home, grow a community, and explore a world full of adventure in this cozy third-person life and adventure game. Farm, customize, explore, battle, and create your own story in Averlyn.

5270220.name: Sound Bounded
5270220.desc: 声音就是一切。探索黑暗、迷雾笼罩的世界，激活神秘水晶，躲避一名能通过声音发现你的不懈猎手。尖叫可以跑得更快，保持安静才能躲藏，并利用环境为自己谋生。每一个声音都会带来后果。

5271070.name: Sort Their TEETH
5271070.desc: 《Sort Their TEETH》是一款超现实第一人称分类游戏，舞台是一座位于活体巨口中的博物馆。捡起散落的牙齿，将它们归还给各种古怪生物展品，逐渐清理凌乱的地面。收集金牙，解锁奇妙升级，让分类整理更加畅快！

5284880.name: Star Imperium
5284880.desc: 《Star Imperium》是一款科幻集换式卡牌与构筑策略游戏。两位指挥官为各自的母星而战，跨越星海展开厮杀。调遣舰船、士兵、力场与行动牌，以五大资源阵营为后盾——反物质、晶体、光、金属与有机物。

5288370.name: Casino School
5288370.desc: 在 Casino School，跟五位脾气古怪的老师学扑克、轮盘、21点和老虎机：40 节课、12 个小游戏，还有真正的赌桌。没有风险、没有压力，也不用真钱，尽情试验各种策略，还有满满的幽默。

5290560.name: Tichu
5290560.desc: Play Tichu in a polished digital adaptation of the 2v2 partnership card game. Compete in Ranked or Unranked online matches, challenge AI opponents across three difficulties, master special cards, and track your progres…

5293240.name: Minus Zero
5293240.desc: Minus Zero is an island survival game about scavenging, crafting, and fighting to endure a hostile island. Explore a mysterious bunker, face zombies within and dangerous threats outside, then build the tools and solar-…

5295270.name: Last Order
5295270.desc: A narrative adventure set in a quiet bar in Shimokitazawa, Tokyo. Choose a cocktail, listen to stories of life, and leave each night with a poem—all presented through a distinctive visual style inspired by traditional …

5303440.name: The Temple
5303440.desc: In the far future, explore an abandoned planet aboard three distinct vehicles. Drive deep beneath the sea, glide high amongst the clouds, and fly even higher in orbit. Immerse in the atmosphere, avoid eldritch dangers …

5303520.name: Amber Eyes
5303520.desc: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.

5308970.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
5308970.desc: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly…

5311350.name: GNOMINAL
5311350.desc: 欠债 $50,000。每晚打卡上班，射碎花园小矮人，拿走它们藏着的钱。但每发子弹都会从账户余额中扣费。下班号声响起时，您可以带着收入离开，也可以留下加班：收益更高，损失也更大。

5314080.name: One More Donut
5314080.desc: 将由2500多个美味甜甜圈堆成的大山变成完美有序的艺术品！在这款极具解压感的分类整理模拟游戏中，整理美味甜点，解锁实用升级，并在温馨的 Lo-Fi 音乐中放松身心。

5315960.name: Asteroid : Vector Zero
5315960.desc: Asteroid : Vector Zero is a fast-paced arcade space shooter where momentum, precision and quick reactions keep you alive. Blast through asteroids, dodge incoming threats and master your ship as the chaos escalates. Eas…

5316210.name: Metromino
5316210.desc: 用四格骨牌拼块打造属于你的大都市！从小村庄起步，发展城市，修建道路和各种设施，赚取数百万财富，同时让居民保持幸福。

5319410.name: 我的员工都死了！灵异大亨
5319410.desc: 员工都死了，生意却才刚开始！在这款充满黑色幽默的单人庄园经营模拟游戏中，招募幽灵、培养技能，经营心灵摄影、降灵会、鬼屋和幽灵导览等生意。一边提高利润与声望，一边控制外界对超自然现象的怀疑。游客以为眼前的一切都是特效，你却知道这些幽灵货真价实。规划道路与建筑，照顾幽灵员工的能量，帮助他们了却心愿，再决定何时送他们离去。应对每年的税款与挑战，让庄园持续经营，并以每年年末的银行余额刷新自己的资金纪录。活人的账单，就交给死者来帮忙解决吧。
5319410.en: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon

5323210.name: Dead Last
5323210.desc: 《Dead Last》是一款适合 2-8 名好友游玩的恐怖派对游戏，怪物只是危险的一半。在恐怖的小游戏中活下来，用道具自救并给其他人使绊子。无论如何，死也别垫底。

5326750.name: Backrooms Open World
5326750.desc: Welcome to the first Massively Multiplayer Open World Backrooms experience on Steam. Explore the Backrooms, fight Entities and other Players, join Factions to increase chances of survival and escape.

5328980.name: Cosmos Knights - Abyss Survivors
5328980.desc: 在这款像素风格的动作生存 Roguelite 游戏中，守护盖娅帝国的各个世界，抵御深渊的威胁！迎战成群袭来的怪物，组合强大的技能，在每场冒险中不断变强，挑战强大的首领。

5329460.name: Hill Sphere
5329460.desc: Hill Sphere is an in-depth Space 4X/Grand Strategy game with a strong focus on realism, economic and logistical depth. Lead your nation into a sector full of rival powers and win through ingenuity, clever planning, and…

5332920.name: ShotMachine
5332920.desc: A turn-based western roguelite where your revolver is a slot machine. Load it round by round, fuse bullets into jackpot rounds, let your winnings ride at THE COUNT and take the rails all the way to The House, the casin…

5342300.name: Amateur Football Together
5342300.desc: 5v5 cage football with your mates. Everyone controls one player, AI keepers guard the goals and bots fill empty spots. Pass, cross, dribble and shoot under the sunset lights. Quick matches, quick chat, no offsides.

5347440.name: Deadshift
5347440.desc: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player & multiplayer, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave…

5348720.name: DEATHKILL
5348720.desc: With reality itself rupturing, Cael, prisoner of an unnamed cult, escapes his captors. Unmake everything.

5349740.name: Hellwake
5349740.desc: 英雄自行战斗，你来打造杀戮机器。一款拥有深度经典刷宝体验的黑暗奇幻自动战斗 RPG：七大职业、暗金、套装与符文之语，一座待你建设的城镇，还能焚尽每轮冒险换取永久力量，一路深入地狱七幕。

5351940.name: Triads
5351940.desc: TRIADS is a sci-fi turn-based tactical combat game where you command cybernetically linked mechs across hex-based battlefields. Maneuver for position, manage initiative, exploit firing arcs and rear attacks, combine fi…

5353560.name: 摆摊之王
5353560.desc: 一款可单人治愈躺平、可四人联机淘金撤离的可爱卡通休闲派对游戏！站摊爆币、拾取暴富，休闲又欢乐！

5365010.name: Crônicas Improváveis
5365010.desc: 无需召集朋友，也能独自体验桌面角色扮演游戏！创建你的英雄，用自己的语言交流和行动。AI 游戏主持人将为你讲述故事、扮演角色，并引领你体验由作者精心编写的史诗战役。从《群兽王座》第一幕开启你的冒险旅程。

5366920.name: After Troy
5366920.desc: 一款以希腊神话为背景的牌组构建类 Rogue 角色扮演游戏。从四位英雄中选一位，每局探索一张新地图，构建牌库，招募同伴，夺取城市。逐级挑战十二项伟业，在排行榜上比拼实力。可以独自游玩，也可以与最多三位好友在线或在同一台 PC 上一起玩。

5370260.name: 一起堆杂物塔
5370260.desc: 朋友不就是用来一起拿破烂搭高塔的吗？在 Junk Tower Together 中，最多 8 名玩家轮流堆叠各种离谱的物件，在崩塌边缘挑战平衡，一起搭出一座疯狂高塔！

5375950.name: Put It Away Please
5375950.desc: 暑假里，按照妈妈留下的便条，把食品一样样收进冰箱的短篇解谜恐怖游戏。听到身后有脚步声时，别忘了回头。【预计通关时间：30分钟】

5377120.name: Purplestar
5377120.desc: A dead island. A town crawling with the Mindless. Something in the woods that only moves when you look away, and smiles before it kills. Scavenge, forge your weapons, hold your base against raiders and survive the nigh…

5378450.name: Goblin Hoarder
5378450.desc: Big mess. Little goblin. Goblins and humans are at war, and thousands of stolen treasures need sorting! Fill shelves, grow towers, and unlock magical upgrades and gadgets in a cozy, family-friendly sorting adventure th…

5379430.name: Stormtide Skies
5379430.desc: Take command of a steam-powered airship and battle across the storm-torn skies. Fight solo, challenge AI, compete online, experience a cinematic story, or survive the relentless waves and colossal bosses of Redwake Sie…

5381450.name: 渊生 ABYSSAL
5381450.desc: 从一枚细胞长成你亲手拼出的怪物。选择草食、杂食或肉食，在 100 级的成长中改造口器、尖刺与鞭毛，闯过试炼，咬破培养皿。也可以用单细胞挑战无尽生存。

5382560.name: Mana League
5382560.desc: Fast 7v7 fantasy football with dwarves, orcs, goblins and a lot more. Curl it, chip it or fire a Zigzag Bolt past the keeper. Cast Team Spells, dodge mine carts and play with up to 4 friends on couch co-op or online.

5383780.name: Stompworks
5383780.desc: They fired you, then repossessed your whole town. They missed the mech under the tarp. Build a war machine from 59 parts, put a different gun on each arm, and stomp through 10 levels of wave combat and boss fights to t…

5384150.name: DaVincis Delivery Service
5384150.desc: Leonardo da Vinci is broke, so he delivers pizza by flying machine. Steer with one stick, crank the rotor with the other and set your wobbling pizza stack down on balconies, ships and bell towers in 85 hand-built level…

5385320.name: Wolfsbanner: Medieval Kingdom RPG
5385320.desc: 手持长剑，以第三人称展开残酷的近身搏杀：格挡、推撞、击晕，并以血腥处决终结身披重甲的敌人。随后，在同一个世界里、无需加载画面，作为国王统治一座你亲手一砖一石建起的1403年中欧鲜活城镇。

5387070.name: Contest Lab
5387070.desc: Contest LAB is a collection of 24 keyboard-and-mouse skill trials. Test your reactions, precision, memory, and coordination solo, survive the Gauntlet, or compete online with friends for a place on the leaderboards.

5388370.name: Femme Fury(Pure Classic Simple Action Game)
5388370.desc: A fast-paced action game with a taste for lowbrow sexuality. No puzzles. No complicated progression. Just you, your enemies, and a little bit of strategy. Use your surroundings, outsmart your enemies, and find your own…

5391260.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
5391260.desc: Fish It! 是一款舒适的收纳游戏，将 4,100 多条鱼放回水族箱，填满水缸，解锁技能，将混乱店铺打造成整洁的天堂。

5391450.name: The Waking Deep - No Gods Above Nor Below
5391450.desc: A science-fiction real-time strategy game inspired by the classics of the genre, with a range of new ideas and concepts. The conflict between land and naval units, and the ability to reshape the map by building bridges…

5397720.name: The Spectrum Retreat: Redux
5397720.desc: 《The Spectrum Retreat: Redux》是一款氛围浓郁、令人不安的第一人称解谜惊悚游戏，专为现代硬件从零重制。

5398740.name: Starwaste
5398740.desc: Starwaste 是一款以探索、生存和建造为核心的体素太空沙盒游戏。拆解残骸、研究资源，把废弃的垃圾场变成基地——独自行动，或与船员并肩合作。

5400000.name: Upstart Tycoon
5400000.desc: An incremental tycoon about getting rich in a crooked city. Play as a thief, a dirty cop, a 9–5 worker or a suburban teen, and climb from nobody to the person Port Vesper can't function without. Every run, the city you…

5401070.name: Kingdom of Pieces
5401070.desc: Relax with 20 free jigsaw puzzles and difficulties ranging from 24 to 500 pieces. Explore animals, nature, Japan, travel and fantasy at your own pace.

5403060.name: Everything Simulator
5403060.desc: Choose a world and explore it. Walk the volcanic plains of Venus and fly from the ground to orbit, swim and dive across an ocean planet, or ride mine carts through old tunnels alone or online with friends. Three worlds…

5403320.name: 寻长生
5403320.desc: 一款以秦朝为背景的三消战斗RPG。扮演秦军士兵、道家道士或皇帝影卫，从咸阳出发，穿越塞外，前往昆仑寻求长生仙药。通过消除方块积累能量、释放技能，在策略战斗中击败沿途敌人。三种角色各具特色，三种难度各藏真相，一段关于长生与人性的史诗旅程。

5404780.name: PTW
5404780.desc: A fighting game with no fighting. When two players meet, the higher level wins. Levels are sold one at a time, one press each. Right now, someone on the board is one level above you.

5409200.name: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon
5409200.desc: Start with a tent, a shovel and an empty wallet. Pan your first gold, hire a crew and earn your way to heavy machinery in a clay-styled mining management sim. Choose your prospector, explore with Pepper and build a min…

5409770.name: Salem 1692
5409770.desc: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for p…

5410740.name: DIFFERENCE HOUSE ― 找出全部51处不同才能离开
5410740.desc: 两个看起来一模一样的房间。里面藏着 51 处不同：家具的朝向、数量、颜色、大小。不找出全部不同，就无法离开这栋房子。一款靠走动、对比和记忆力的第一人称耐力找不同游戏。

5417940.name: 速速修仙
5417940.desc: 速速修仙是一款文字挂机修仙游戏。排好行动队列，剩下的交给时间：修为满就自动突破，生命值低了就自己找吃的；万一耗尽而亡，转生后的你会更强。打怪、炼丹、造法宝，从炼气一路挂到登仙。

5418650.name: 钢铁海战：饱和打击
5418650.desc: 海平面上涨，只剩最后一座岛。从一台机器人、一座核心开始，建起全自动的战争工厂；在巡航导弹、无人机蜂群与弹道导弹的饱和打击下守住海岸，再用导弹、运输机与机甲跨海反击，夺回被铁幕重工占领的十一座岛屿。

5419140.name: Ludoman
5419140.desc: **Ludoman** is a life simulator set in snowy Russia. Pay off a 250,000-ruble mortgage, work, gamble your money, and explore an open world. One life, complete freedom, and multiple endings. Your fate is in your hands!

5421790.name: 喵神社
5421790.desc: 来到九藏喵窝《喵神社》，在樱花与暖灯环绕的猫咪神社中，不限次数抽取签运卡，阅读包含爱情等生活方面的祝福与提示。搭配 7 首适合工作、看书时聆听的音乐，享受悠闲的神社时光。

5423300.name: 碧海遗城
5423300.desc: 《碧海遗城》是一款六角棋盘上的合成构筑游戏，合成的形状、数量与阶数都是策略的一部分，搭配特性符石、秘宝规则与古城特殊机制，一步步叠高连锁与得分倍率。用有限体力解开失落海岛的重重机关，带着你的构筑闯入王室宝库，冲击全球排行榜。

5423890.name: MYTHHUNT
5423890.desc: 独自行动，或与最多四名玩家合作，在危机四伏的开放森林中狩猎神秘生物。搜集补给、猎捕野生动物、制作装备并改装枪械。在每次遭遇中活下来，抵达撤离点，把来之不易的战利品带回猎人小屋。

5424370.name: 太阳骑士与邪恶试炼
5424370.desc: 一款将像素美术与立体光影结合的单人动作角色扮演游戏。探索村庄、森林与诅咒之地，在近战、闪避和技能搭配中挑战祭坛首领与十二魔神。收集装备、强化镶嵌、孵化宠物，也能在篝火旁合成补给、耕种和整备。踏上一段关于失去、记忆与重新前行的旅程。
5424370.en: Sun Knight and the Evil Trial

5424390.name: 猜想数独
5424390.desc: 一款围绕逻辑推理与分支猜想设计的经典9×9数独游戏。分别标记假设与推理，管理候选数字并逐层回溯，在十个渐进章节和10万道题中理解每一步解法。

5428150.name: Baseballball
5428150.desc: 一款以棒球为核心的运动生涯与人生模拟游戏。从16岁的高中球员起步，在比赛中亲自投球、击球、跑垒与防守，同时兼顾学业、生活、兼职及投资，向职业赛场迈进；还可挑战多种球类运动，与电脑或朋友同场竞技。

5429590.name: Potato Factory
5429590.desc: 被队友落在火星，风暴就要来了，你还差一笔钱才能造好火箭。种土豆、炸薯片，从第一单做起，再用赚来的钱扩大生产。 那批变异土豆又准时送到了。你觉得这批货能卖多少钱？

5433150.name: 为了熊蜂
5433150.desc: 你是布鲁姆希尔德·冯·胡默尔邦默尔。二月，你独自醒来：找一个土洞，采集花粉和花蜜，养育你的女儿们，扩建你的蜂巢。九个月里，你要对抗胡蜂、鸟儿、风暴和酷暑。到了十一月，只有一件事要紧：你的蜂群还在吗？

5436360.name: BitLoaf
5436360.desc: Little 3D Loafs live on your Windows desktop. They wander, react to you, hang out with each other, and find their own fun while you work. Even secret characters! With more to come with updates.

5438690.name: Oh Baby Blocks
5438690.desc: 一款温馨的编织方块交换益智游戏。交换、消除、连锁毛线方块，击败 24 位戴帽子的 Boss，挑战 80 道手工谜题和每日挑战，或与朋友本地、在线对战，支持跨平台。

5441670.name: Six Coins
5441670.desc: Six Coins is a single-player, turn-based card game where coins are both your life and your currency. Draw to improve your hand, stand to save your coins, and equip trinkets for an edge at the table. Chase a matching pa…

5448900.name: BlobBobbing
5448900.desc: Drag squishy gummy blobs onto their twins and watch them fuse into rarer, shinier blobs. A cozy merge idler where every blob wobbles, stretches and bounces like real jelly, and your nest keeps bobbing and earning while…

5449370.name: Luna Star Rancher
5449370.desc: 探索。成长。建造。照顾露娜，饲养奇妙生物，让你的发明成为现实！获取经验值、发展牧场、建造火箭、挑战首领，揭开未知世界的秘密。

5451830.name: Ordanum
5451830.desc: Ordanum 是一款以连招为核心的 PvP 自走棋，符印顺序是驱动系统。排列并重排符印，然后观察你的造物与其他玩家的构筑对战。

5453070.name: KUROSHIO: Neon Blood
5453070.desc: Tokyo, at night, in the rain. Twelve years after vanishing, Kyōsuke Narumi comes home to a yakuza war. An open-world crime saga: street fights, katana and gunfights, police chases, BASE jumps off neon towers, mountain-…

5453240.name: Mai Petite Saigon
5453240.desc: Mai-Anne aced everything she was told to. When her little brother disappears, she drops it all and dives into Paris's drawing underground to find him. A 240-page graphic novel, read page by page, with its own music and…

5453830.name: 总部的阴谋
5453830.desc: 扮演企业调查员，探索集团总部的阴谋。在第一或第三人称视角中寻找线索、破解谜题并对抗失控机器人。免费试玩版包含三层工厂、Lucy支线和金库Boss。

5454430.name: NO SUCH MONSTERS
5454430.desc: 一个男孩，一支手电筒，一栋再也不像家的房子。《No Such Monsters》是一款横版恐怖冒险游戏。探索漆黑的房间、地下通道与破败的教堂，解开环境谜题，逃离紧追不舍的怪物。

5455460.name: Backmare: Return of the nightmare
5455460.desc: 沉浸在 Backmare 中，这是一款旨在扭曲你的现实并考验你神智的心理生存恐怖体验。在这里，生存不仅仅是逃跑——而是将一段被时间遗忘的破碎真相重新拼凑在一起。

5456360.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
5456360.desc: 《昭幽：阴阳渡》是一款融合阵容构筑与多人合作的塔防游戏。在连接昭界与幽界的防线上，招募英雄、组合羁绊、锻造装备，并从天道馈赠中选择适合本局的强化。每波进攻之间，你都需要权衡资源投入，提升英雄质量，应对隐形、飞行与特殊敌人。单人挑战或与朋友协作，在不同地图中共同守住阴阳渡。

5457380.name: Bust 10
5457380.desc: 《Bust 10（爆十）》是一款融合了底池博弈与互坑乐趣的合家欢派对卡牌游戏。通过下注施压、巧用道具与英雄技能，在极简的“凑十”规则中算计对手。一旦爆牌，赢家将挑选惩罚道具狠狠砸向输家。本作目前支持单人对战 AI，在线联机派对模式正在开发中。

5458430.name: Ghost Girl Requiem
5458430.desc: Play as Haruhiko, a young man who can hear ghosts, in a five-chapter supernatural adventure. Search rooms, uncover clues through conversation, show or combine items, and fight spirits with paper talismans. The choices …

5461540.name: 午夜异客店
5461540.desc: 外婆失踪的第七天，你推开她那间只在午夜营业的杂货铺。柜台玻璃下压着一张店规——字迹是外婆的，但不全是她写的。守规矩能活过今夜，可规矩有时会把门外的人推开。七个午夜，一场规则怪谈，一段人情。

5462060.name: SheepTag: Dragons
5462060.desc: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning esc…

5462560.name: Jar of Gnomes
5462560.desc: An incremental colony game in an allotment garden. Hundreds of gnomlings pick berries, merge fruit in a magic cauldron and fling it through the air. When the run slows down, make jam: jars buy lasting upgrades in the G…

5463460.name: Veltarum
5463460.desc: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals o…

5463810.name: Wall Punch: Escape The Walls Simulator
5463810.desc: Break through 50,000 bricks. Time to escape the walls. Punch your way to freedom! Break through walls, punch out the walls and escape prison one punch at a time! Smash through tougher walls, discover new areas, and bec…

5464560.name: HordeNight 1996
5464560.desc: 1996, somewhere in Coyote City... the dead won’t stay dead. Blast through a blood-soaked zombie horde in this fast-paced retro FPS. Shred them limb by limb, chain brutal kills, and make sure every last one of them RIPs.

5470000.name: Starwinder
5470000.desc: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Togethe…

5472080.name: SHRED A BILLION
5472080.desc: SHRED A BILLION是一款关于钱山的第一人称增量游戏！徒手抓钞票，用水桶舀钱，不断升级，把十亿美元统统喂进碎钞机。只剩9亿9999万9999张钞票了！

5475470.name: Sort of Cheesy: Tidy up the Cheese Cave
5475470.desc: A cozy first-person sorting game where you play as a rat with a nose for cheese. Sniff out, stack, and shelve over 300 types of cheese and milk. Complete sets to earn wedges, unlock cheesy powers like the Cheese’nado, …

5476460.name: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
5476460.desc: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》是一款末日题材的射击游戏。玩家将面对僵尸，以及叛乱者的威胁，需要防守僵尸的袭击，也需要出去探索收集物资并躲避僵尸和叛乱者的袭击。拿起你的武器，在这个末日中生存下来。

5477240.name: STASIS LAST RAIL
5477240.desc: 带有西部风情的复古像素风随机生成俯视角射击游戏。闯过5个章节共50层，摧毁刷怪洞，用停滞技能冻结飞来的子弹，并击败每5层出现的Boss（最终Boss拥有两个形态）。

5481910.name: Everybody Hates You in TOKYO
5481910.desc: 1999年的东京，全世界都想要你的命。在这款节奏极快、血腥且充满黑色幽默的复古第一人称射击游戏中全力反击！面对无穷无尽的敌人群潮、夸张狂暴的强悍火力、永久属性升级，以及16个难度不断飙升的噩梦竞技场。没有盟友，绝不留情。这不过是东京平常的一天。

5482210.name: Hide & Chisel
5482210.desc: 用大理石雕出你的身体，然后像雕像一样一动不动！Hide & Chisel 是一款捉迷藏游戏，你可以把一块石头雕成任何你能想到的形状。躲开策展人和他的锤子！

5482330.name: Wayfarion
5482330.desc: Wayfarion 是一款 2D 太空动作 Roguelite。你将探索程序生成的星区、进行即时战斗、装配武器与无人机，并在星港交易战利品。舰船被毁即结束本局，技能树执照与已解锁的船体则会保留。可单人游玩，或进行在线合作。

5486380.name: Taenera's Offer
5486380.desc: 在一颗濒临毁灭的沙漠星球上，体验科幻题材的撤离射击游戏。搜寻武器、补给和贵重物品，接受高风险合约，在战斗中寻找撤离机会。运用精准射击、灵活闪避和环境物理效果，在危机四伏的世界中生存下来，赚够离开星球的钱。

5487170.name: Hellstorm Gunners
5487170.desc: 和最多九位好友一起驾驶一架B-17飞行堡垒。从起飞一路飞到着陆，操纵机枪，扑灭大火，轰炸真实的历史目标。用自己的名字游玩单人战役，或体验另外十一种模式，从空袭工厂到僵尸雨。空着的枪位由电脑队友补上。

5488100.name: Real War: Not Fake
5488100.desc: The fake-mobile incremental arcade game now made real! Shoot enemies, increase your army, gather coins, upgrade your gear, and defeat bosses to complete levels!

5489480.name: JustLayIt
5489480.desc: Just Lay It is a train survival strategy game where you lay tracks, gather resources, and fight monsters to keep a train running across the desert. Defend against waves of enemies and design efficient routes to reach y…

5489920.name: Why Not Fly That?
5489920.desc: Strap thrusters to shopping carts, fridges, and everyday objects in this single-player physics sandbox. Build your own flying machine, assign its controls, and fly, tumble, and tackle obstacles. Experiment with each de…

5491360.name: Toy Breakers
5491360.desc: Fight from a toy’s-eye view in an oversized house. Join Captain Clip’s repair crew, build your own blaster, and hold the Kitchen relay in replayable Battle Cards. Take on bots or bring a friend into an online match.

5492190.name: Before it Falls
5492190.desc: 走进已关闭多年的 St. Elora 医院，在拆除前完成最后一次技术检查。恢复供电，探索大楼，查阅遗留记录。Before it Falls 是一款以探索和环境解谜为核心的第一人称心理恐怖游戏。

5492690.name: Night Wash: GE-418-NK
5492690.desc: 在城郊的隧道式洗车场上夜班。在窗口收款，登记车牌，让刷子运转到六点。隧道卡住时，你要出去亲手排除故障。经理把规章留在布告板上。照做就不会有事。

5494180.name: 谁杀死了坤坤
5494180.desc: 这是一个恐怖类型的第一人称冒险游戏，你进入了艾坤市首富坤坤的豪宅，房间内的一切都已经被诡异控制。坤坤设下了一个个谜题来阻止闯入的人，你能解开这些谜题并逃离坤坤的豪宅吗？

5494840.name: Don’t  Drop!!
5494840.desc: “Don't Drop!!” is a challenging 3D action game that captures the essence of platformers. Control the ball using only jump commands as you aim for the top of the tower! Go through repeated trial and error, and experienc…

5495060.name: Sengoku Fields of Empire
5495060.desc: SENGOKU combines samurai action, economic management and grand strategy in feudal Japan. Lead the Tokugawa clan, build farms and trade networks, recruit warriors, forge alliances, conquer castles and rise through the I…

5495580.name: Extreme Paddle Board
5495580.desc: 站起来，用力划，尽量别掉下去。驾着桨板在世界各地的狂野河流上竞速，穿过激流、冲下瀑布、飞离跳台，还要提防好友把你撞进水里。摇晃、落水、爬回去，赢下比赛。

5495680.name: Prophunt Slop
5495680.desc: Be a prop and hide, but with a little twist. Play classic Hide & Seek, or jump into Generator Mode: fix generators, disguise as props, stun the hunter and escape through the gates before you end up on the electric chai…

5495830.name: Blubbis Abenteuer
5495830.desc: German-language interactive children’s book with full German voice narration – no English version available

5496480.name: FRAGILE!
5496480.desc: Online co-op moving company for 1–4 players. Carry sofas, pianos and chandeliers with both hands through 10 places and 40 contracts... and break nothing. A new Daily Contract every day, Steam leaderboards and Twitch ch…

5497040.name: 挂机伏魔录
5497040.desc: 招募最多五名侠客，组成你的伏魔战阵。自动战斗、离线积累收益，刷取带有随机词条的装备。搭配角色战法与主辅心法，挑战秘境首领和无尽劫塔。《挂机伏魔录》是一款国风单人挂机 RPG。

5498750.name: Candy Diggers
5498750.desc: Drill through candy planets, catch sweet critters and fuse upgrades into wild synergies in this cheerful digging roguelite. Every run brings candy home to your factory town, where belts and buildings turn it into coins…

5499670.name: Shelfish
5499670.desc: Undo anything. Nothing locks. A cozy organizing puzzle where every drag snaps into place, a ghost shows exactly where each thing will land, and any mistake is one press from fixed. Tidy 40 levels across five rooms with…

5501850.name: Hello Doctor
5501850.desc: The worst ambulance company in town is hiring. Answer the phone, rush to the patient and get them to the hospital alive: one drives, one navigates, two in the back keep them breathing. Online co-op for up to 4, real ph…

5503670.name: 黑魔传奇 - 卡牌
5503670.desc: 《黑魔传奇 - 卡牌》是一款刷刷刷的单机传奇类RPG，角色基于卡牌的表现形式，但它是传奇的玩法，角色打怪升级和刷装备。有战士、法师、道士这三种职业，可以探索森林和地牢，与怪物和Boss战斗。游戏使用了3D和2D结合的表现手法，超过170张地图，你可以边刷怪边看风景。而怪物超过167种，等级超过100级。

5504190.name: Zero Mass
5504190.desc: 把巨型小行星挖到一块不剩！开采、切割并拆解程序生成的太空岩体，让质量从100%降到0%。收集珍贵资源，升级采矿船，部署无人机，实现作业自动化。在这款太空采矿增量游戏中，尽享开采与成长的满足感。

5507950.name: Chess Lords
5507950.desc: 一部电影般的中世纪国际象棋传奇！在战役中挑战 12 位对手，体验自由对战，破解 24 道杀棋谜题，见证每一次吃子化为专属于该棋子的残酷处决。

5508050.name: 摸鱼修个仙
5508050.desc: 《摸鱼修个仙》是一款挂在桌面底边的像素修仙放置游戏。招纳弟子、修建洞府、召唤妖物，让小宗门在你的桌面上热闹起来。闲下来，就拎起小修士逗一逗，收收灵石、挑战Boss，或传承法脉、蕴养新的弟子。

5508060.name: 再来亿竿
5508060.desc: 《再来亿竿》是一款轻松的像素风桌面钓鱼游戏。把湖光山色放在屏幕一角，让小伙伴陪你悠闲垂钓。在工作与休息的间隙，收集各地鱼种，偶遇稀有异色鱼，完成当地委托，升级钓具，把旅途中的收获写进手册。说好最后一竿？那就再来亿竿！

5509990.name: Cozy Puzzle Simulator 3D
5509990.desc: 在四间温馨的房间里，体验逼真的3D拼图，享受片刻闲暇。挑选100款拼图，或用自己的图片制作专属拼图。在变换的日光、窗外的雨声与舒缓音乐中，从小拼图开始，或挑战500片大拼图。进度随时保存，下次回来接着拼。

5513420.name: C.L.T.
5513420.desc: A Brazilian top-down crime sandbox inspired by GTA 1, GTA 2 and Chinatown Wars. Steal cars, turn intersections into police pileups and switch between two protagonists. Take jobs, race illegally or grab a helicopter and…

5514810.name: 记忆大王
5514810.desc: 记住可爱动物场景里的小细节，图片消失后凭记忆作答！和朋友来一场 2—8 人锦标赛，看看谁记得更多。还可以导入自己的图片、编写问题和四个选项，把专属题包分享给朋友一起挑战。

5515440.name: World Craft Dream Island
5515440.desc: 用方块一块块搭建你的梦想岛屿！可以独自游玩，也能与最多10位好友联机。在这款温馨的体素沙盒中挖矿、合成、熬过黑夜，建起46座蓝图建筑，驯服会说话的宠物，开启传送门，前往Boss镇守的奇异之境。

5516980.name: Tidy Up: Bricks n Blocks
5516980.desc: Thousands of toy bricks are tipped across a cozy toy shop floor. Sort each one onto the shelf for its shape and into the bin for its color, alone or in online co-op for up to 4. Play the 14-room Campaign, or put all 11…

5518650.name: WHUCK Protocol
5518650.desc: Pilot a customizable spacecraft in WHUCK Protocol, a top-down voxel sci-fi roguelite. Survive waves of hostile machines, evolve powerful weapons, defeat massive bosses, and choose when to extract or descend deeper to u…

5519000.name: Command At Your Own Risk!
5519000.desc: 8 friends. One starship. Questionable leadership. Take your station, power the weapons, and turn panic into victory in Command at Your Own Risk! Only the host buys—friends join FREE by browser. The bridge is yours. The…

5520650.name: Clip Out: Backrooms
5520650.desc: 一款以 Backrooms 为题材的 PSX 风格撤离类 Roguelite，支持单人或双人在线合作。探索程序生成的关卡，搜刮战利品，活着撤离以升级装备。

5521040.name: Koyland
5521040.desc: Found your village on the real map of Istanbul. Send caravans over real bridges and ferry lines, raise walls, train soldiers and grow from a humble village into a beylik in a free online strategy game where every stree…

5521470.name: Needle in a Haystack Simulator in a Haystack of Needle in a Haystack Simulators
5521470.desc: 5,000,000 games on VAPOR, and all but one are clones. From your bedroom PC, screen procedurally generated store pages, stamp each fake on the detail that gives it away, put bots to work, and dig through the haystack fo…

5522790.name: Chemtris
5522790.desc: Create massive chain reactions in this falling-block puzzler. Climb the leaderboards in Arcade, survive a roguelite lab expedition, or try Adventure mode for weird combos, plus tons of unlocks along the way!

5523630.name: Eleven FC Manager
5523630.desc: The most old-school football manager you'll find. Start in the 10th division, build your squad, pick your XI, adjust at half-time and climb to the top flight: 200 clubs, 10 divisions, 7,000+ players. No microtransactio…

5526540.name: Air Crisis
5526540.desc: 从航母起飞，投身疾速街机空战。在世界各地的五种场景中，挑战数十项任务，从珊瑚海岸和农田，到沙漠、冰封峡湾和港口城市。锁定敌机，闪避导弹，打击地面目标。

5527800.name: No Asteroids
5527800.desc: 90 天后，一颗小行星将撞上地球。政府招标，来投标的只有一个矿工，自带矿镐。他分文不取，说小行星会自己买单。以第一人称挖掉 500 万立方米，卖掉矿石，给飞船买舰炮，让它们在你挖矿时一起开火。可单人游玩，也支持最多 8 人在线合作。

5528590.name: Kitsune Kart
5528590.desc: 化身兽耳妖怪少女，驰骋于24条源自日本民间传说的赛道，从狐狸神社一路冲到雷神的雷云。漂移、加速，向对手扔出妖怪恶作剧，夺下领先位置。

5529320.name: 无尽之路
5529320.desc: 无尽之路是一克游戏品牌推出的无尽系列的开山之作，该款为横版闯关游戏，进入游戏后玩家需要用“W,S,A,D键”控制主角的“上,下,左,右”，L键为攻击键，K键为奔跑，J键为跳跃，与宠物猫对话即可切换主角(莱斯德·金)，与宠物狗对话即可切换主角(埃·金)，ent回车键为交互键进行人物的对话和事件的发生，ESC为菜单栏键，游戏里还有商店功能，与商人对话即可进入商店页面，初始默认男主为埃·金，使用枪手闯关更为容易。

5530490.name: HachaMeccha Reversi
5530490.desc: 不用等回合！最多4人同时发射棋子，展开每局约2分钟的实时黑白棋大战。棋子空中碰撞、特殊棋子和蓄力射击，连角落也能翻转，随时逆转战局！支持在线对战、2对2组队，还有生存挑战和得分挑战等单人模式！

5531610.name: GBald
5531610.desc: The maid asks if you have an appointment. It's your house. Take it back in GBald, a third-person arcade shooter. Dodge flying pots, fight through 30 waves of furious staff and roosters, and hit the gym between waves.

5531990.name: Rare on the Line
5531990.desc: 抛出鱼线，钓起箱子，发现值得收藏的钓鱼装备。追寻稀有涂装、图案与磨损，搭配心仪的装备，与好友分享开箱时刻。通过 Steam 创意工坊创作并分享涂装，与社区一起塑造游戏的未来。

5533560.name: 奶蛙大作战
5533560.desc: 奶蛙，出击！ 一款轻松上头的 2D 生存射击小游戏：你是一只圆滚滚的奶蛙，在源源不断的突变奶蛙群中活下来，边打边变强。 核心玩法 · 自动开火 + 手动瞄准，键盘走位躲子弹，上手即玩 · 击杀掉落金钱与经验，升级即变强，越打越爽 · 4 种难度：和平、普通、困难、虚假，敌人数量与收益同步提升 · BOSS 盾兵 耄耋蜘蛛 嘉豪大盗登场，考验你的走位和输出节奏

5533870.name: Vapeur & Rouages
5533870.desc: A turn-based tactical roguelike in a steampunk sky archipelago. Start with a single wrench strike, earn a new spell or upgrade after every fight, choose your next door and climb as high as you can. Endless floors, shar…

5534310.name: Find The Needle: Haystack Hunt
5534310.desc: 挖开一座由一百万根稻草堆成的干草堆，卖掉干草，然后建造传送带和机械臂来拆掉整座草堆。十根藏起来的针会带来永久加成。一款轻松惬意的第一人称工厂游戏。

5534320.name: 내일의 챔피언 (Tomorrow's Champion)
5534320.desc: 我们每个人的心中，都藏着一辆迷你赛车，对吧？ 自由组合各种零件，打造专属迷你赛车！探索隐藏的零件组合，解锁强大的 OVER DRIVE 技能，通过策略性进站维修超越对手，向冠军发起挑战！ BOOST ON！

5534730.name: One Shade Closer
5534730.desc: Mix paint from 12 basic colors to touch up chipped paint on pillars, doors, lockers and playground equipment. A quiet little game for bedtime or a few spare minutes: just one small repair at a time. No timers, no score…

5534880.name: 战车幸存者：尸潮狂飙
5534880.desc: 驾驶自由改装的战车冲进尸潮！在这款俯视角动作 Roguelite 中，升级并进化六槽武器，召集阿帕奇、释放暴风雪，或用滚筒与双钻头从正面突破。通关解锁车辆模块，打造自己的移动堡垒。

5537810.name: Eras of Myths and Monsters
5537810.desc: Eras of Myths and Monsters is a hero-led turn-based fantasy strategy game inspired by the classics. Explore the world, develop your castles, recruit armies, and lead your heroes into tactical battles. Challenge compute…

5541850.name: Dragon Joust
5541850.desc: Two riders. Four dragons. One sky to rule. Pick the Orc King or the Sorceress Queen, saddle up a fire, ice, poison, or magic dragon, and joust your rivals out of the clouds. Raid villages, summon storms, call a Titan, …

5541950.name: HellRaiders
5541950.desc: 一款融合轻度 Rogue 元素的实时自动战斗游戏。组建恶魔战团，搭配定位与元素协同，精心部署阵容，在深入地狱的每一场战斗中以策略取胜。

5542020.name: Flock Hunt
5542020.desc: A first-person stealth game about taking down mass surveillance cameras and fighting a dystopian future. Every camera you break brings The Flock a little closer. Sneak out at night and destroy cameras with a growing ar…

5543790.name: Off Grid Pop
5543790.desc: 戳破正确的气泡，放过冒牌货。帮助奥蒂斯——一位带着饥饿蟾蜍的沼泽老爷爷——在他的旧电视上熬过30项荒诞的验证码测试。黏土微缩画风、不断升高的压力，还有一个极不讲理的部门，挡在他和“证明自己是人类”之间。

5544230.name: Gorse Roll
5544230.desc: Steer a ray-traced glass marble along floating roads of ice, mirrors and spinning floors. Race the clock through five worlds, hunt hidden sun crystals to earn a sixth, then build your own courses in an editor that trac…

5544950.name: Starward Protocol
5544950.desc: 发射、收集、升级！Starward Protocol是一款增量火箭射击游戏。收集金币，扩展分支升级树，强化机体、燃料和推进器。提升导弹火力，突破密集弹幕，挑战巨型机械首领，向群星进发！

5546020.name: 云养一个女鹅
5546020.desc: 在你的桌面上，云养一个女鹅。挑选一个小朋友，让她住进桌角的小屋：坐在窗口边陪你，画贴纸送你，偶尔调皮，偶尔撒娇。摸摸头、分享零食、陪她玩一会儿；忙的时候，她也会自己玩、安静睡觉。没有打卡压力，只有慢慢熟悉彼此的小日常。

5546750.name: 差使：黄昏引魂人
5546750.desc: 化身阴间差使，横扫汹涌亡者大军的等距视角类幸存者动作游戏。选择武器，组合术法并使其大成，挑战强大的守门将。通过装备与灵脉（被动技能树）打造属于你的构筑。

5547250.name: Pufu
5547250.desc: Action packed 3D cat fighting indie game. It's not an AAA game, probably not even -A. But it's full of adventure, leveling and customization. Also funny.

5547640.name: 成为投资家
5547640.desc: 1956年，从一家拥有500万元初始净资产的投资公司起步，打造属于自己的企业集团。阅读财报，投资股票、收购企业、配置国债，在经济周期中把分红投入下一次机会。一款与好企业和时间同行的投资公司经营模拟游戏。

5547980.name: Stickman Breaks Into the World of Mathematics
5547980.desc: 一场考验走位、瞄准与运算选择的单人横版动作解谜冒险。操控火柴人闯入数字构成的世界，把加减乘除装进枪膛！让每一发子弹，成为答案。

5550020.name: Chains of Three Kingdoms
5550020.desc: 三国题材策略Roguelike。战斗是三消，决策是战略。每局以50名武将与6种阵形组建不同的军团，向与恶魔立约的董卓所据的洛阳进军。

5550890.name: The Perfect Quest: The Drowned King's Hoard
5550890.desc: A text adventure inspired by the Sierra classics. A pirate with a hat and no ship, a sarcastic parrot and a map torn in three: type your way across the Caribbean, dig up chests, forge papers, bribe a skeleton with a fi…

5551040.name: Destination & Acceleration
5551040.desc: 这是一款俯视角平台游戏，你的目标就是通过各个关卡。Destination & Acceleration 是一款真正硬核、有型且公平的游戏。只可惜，你在这里连十关都过不了。

5552940.name: Show: No Mercy
5552940.desc: 开枪后，还能操控子弹！Show: No Mercy 是一款支持 2–8 人在线对战的第一人称射击派对游戏。在海盗岛屿上与好友较量，操控飞行中的子弹绕过掩体，从意想不到的角度命中对手。在不同模式中争夺奖杯，用爆炸、穿透或三连发子弹打乱对手的计划。赢取代币，解锁角色、步枪和刀具外观。瞄准好友，拿下奖杯，成为全场冠军！

5553220.name: 茶の湯シミュレーター
5553220.desc: A quiet tearoom, but chaos in your hands! A first-person tea ceremony simulator where you brew matcha yourself—holding, tilting, and spilling. Nothing is automated, so mistakes get served as is. Score 80+ three times i…

5553760.name: Idle Mind
5553760.desc: 一次点亮一个神经元，直到整个大脑都亮起来。拖动连接神经元，让它们升级，解锁五个脑叶，再通过睡眠变得更强。一款轻松的放置游戏，配有随你成长的原声音乐，还有一段等你揭开的故事。

5555150.name: 决斗纪元
